summary: Build-A-Bear Workshop filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, reporting its board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per common share. The dividend is payable October 8, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on September 24, 2026, with a press release filed as Exhibit 99.1. No advisor, premium, stake, or buyback terms were disclosed. The item is a routine capital-return declaration, implying an annualized yield dependent on the prevailing share price. What to watch: sustainability of the payout versus retail discretionary cash flow and any future special-dividend or repurchase announcements.
